content.text:
Welch Allyn ophthalmology/eye-exam tools are mainly sold under **Welch Allyn / Hillrom / Baxter** and include:

| Tool | What it’s for | Common Welch Allyn options |
|---|---|---|
| **Ophthalmoscope** | Direct exam of retina/optic disc | **PanOptic Plus**, **3.5 V Coaxial**, **Prestige Coaxial-Plus**, PocketScope |
| **Retinoscope** | Objective refraction / estimating prescription | **Elite 3.5 V Streak Retinoscope** |
| **Ophthalmic sets** | Bundled heads + power handle/charger, often ophthalmoscope + retinoscope or otoscope | Welch Allyn ophthalmic diagnostic sets |
| **Vision screener** | Pediatric/primary-care vision screening | Welch Allyn **Spot Vision Screener** |
| **iExaminer system** | Capturing fundus/eye images with compatible Welch Allyn ophthalmoscopes | PanOptic/iExaminer system |

**If you’re buying:**  
- For **med/PA/nursing school**: a basic Welch Allyn coaxial or PocketScope set is usually enough unless your program requires a specific model.  
- For **primary care**: PanOptic Plus is easier for many users because it gives a wider view than standard direct ophthalmoscopes. Welch Allyn says its current ophthalmic sets feature the **PanOptic Plus** and that it includes **Quick Eye alignment** to help align the patient’s gaze. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/?utm_source=openai))  
- For **optometry/ophthalmology training**: consider the **Elite Streak Retinoscope** plus a 3.5 V rechargeable handle; Welch Allyn lists the Elite as a 3.5 V Halogen HPX streak retinoscope, with the power handle sold separately. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/elite-retinoscope/?utm_source=openai))  
- For **retina/optic disc viewing**: PanOptic Plus is marketed as providing a wider view than a standard/pocket ophthalmoscope. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai))
